pkgmetadata.longdescription: The ::gentoo ebuild with touch edge rejection: touches that start within a configurable width (0 to 10 mm, off by default) of the edge of a touch screen are held back until they move more than 3 mm, against ghost touches along the edges; edge swipes keep working. Set per touch screen in System Settings, Touchscreen (needs the matching kde-plasma/plasma-desktop from this overlay). Not upstream.

use.flag: Support using game controllers as input devices
Enable global shortcuts support via kde-plasma/kglobalacceld
Enable ability to support native X11 applications via x11-base/xwayland
